lean.code:
private theorem square_frames
    {Z W : Syn}
    {cz : SyntheticTowerConvergence P Z} {cw : SyntheticTowerConvergence P W}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {h : X ⟶ Z} {j : Z ⟶ W} {k : Y ⟶ W}
    (Mf : ConvergentMap E f cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (Mh : ConvergentMap E h cx.toConvergence cz.toConvergence)
    (Mj : ConvergentMap E j cz.toConvergence cw.toConvergence)
    (hcomm : f ≫ k = h ≫ j)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n m l : ℤ)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (z : ((E.obj Z).sequence.ssData (s+m,p.1+(s+m),p.2)).eInfty)
    (w : ((E.obj W).sequence.ssData (s+m+l,p.1+(s+m+l),p.2)).eInfty)
    (hf : TowerExtensionEquation Mf p s n x y)
    (hh : TowerExtensionEquation Mh p s m x z)
    (hj : TowerExtensionEquation Mj p (s+m) l z w)
    (hnc : TowerNoCrossing Mf p s n ∨ TowerNoCrossing Mh p s m)
    (hncj : TowerNoCrossing Mj p (s+m) l) :
    ∃ (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (cr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (dr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
      (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y ∧
      (P.filtration Z).toAssociatedGraded (s+m) p cr = (infinityGradedIso cz p (s+m)).hom z ∧
      (P.filtration W).toAssociatedGraded (s+m+l) p dr = (infinityGradedIso cw p (s+m+l)).hom w ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ∧
      ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ≫ j = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr ∧
      ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ≫ k = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr := by
  have hthree : ∃ (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (cr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
      (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y ∧
      (P.filtration Z).toAssociatedGraded (s+m) p cr = (infinityGradedIso cz p (s+m)).hom z ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr := by
    rcases hnc with hnf | hnh
    · obtain ⟨_,ar,cr,he,ha,hc⟩ := (tower_extension_iff Mh p s m x z).mp hh
      obtain ⟨br,he',hb⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mf p s n x y hf hnf ar ha
      exact ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,he',he⟩
    · obtain ⟨_,ar,br,he,ha,hb⟩ := (tower_extension_iff Mf p s n x y).mp hf
      obtain ⟨cr,he',hc⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mh p s m x z hh hnh ar ha
      exact ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,he,he'⟩
  obtain ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,haf,hah⟩ := hthree
  obtain ⟨dr,hcj,hd⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mj p (s+m) l z w hj hncj cr hc
  refine ⟨ar,br,cr,dr,ha,hb,hc,hd,haf,hah,hcj,?_⟩
  rw [←haf,Category.assoc,hcomm,←Category.assoc,hah,hcj]

    {f : X ⟶ Y} {h : X ⟶ Z} {j : Z ⟶ W} {k : Y ⟶ W}
    (Mf : ConvergentMap E f cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (Mh : ConvergentMap E h cx.toConvergence cz.toConvergence)
    (Mj : ConvergentMap E j cz.toConvergence cw.toConvergence)
    (hcomm : f ≫ k = h ≫ j)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n m l : ℤ)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (z : ((E.obj Z).sequence.ssData (s+m,p.1+(s+m),p.2)).eInfty)
    (w : ((E.obj W).sequence.ssData (s+m+l,p.1+(s+m+l),p.2)).eInfty)
    (hf : TowerExtensionEquation Mf p s n x y)
    (hh : TowerExtensionEquation Mh p s m x z)
    (hj : TowerExtensionEquation Mj p (s+m) l z w)
    (hnc : TowerNoCrossing Mf p s n ∨ TowerNoCrossing Mh p s m)
    (hncj : TowerNoCrossing Mj p (s+m) l) :
    ∃ (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (cr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (dr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
      (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y ∧
      (P.filtration Z).toAssociatedGraded (s+m) p cr = (infinityGradedIso cz p (s+m)).hom z ∧
      (P.filtration W).toAssociatedGraded (s+m+l) p dr = (infinityGradedIso cw p (s+m+l)).hom w ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ∧
      ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ≫ j = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr ∧
      ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ≫ k = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr

entries.label: paper:2.15
entries.title: A square of extensions without crossings
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 2.15.)


    Consider a homotopy commutative diagram of spectra
    $$\text{see the original commutative diagram}$$
    Suppose $m,n,l\ge 0$, 
    $$\begin{array}{ll}
        x\in E^{s,t}_\infty(X) & y\in E^{s+n,t+n}_\infty(Y),\\
        z\in E^{s+m,t+m}_\infty(Z) & w\in E^{s+m+l,t+m+l}_\infty(W),
    \end{array}$$
    and
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] $d^{f}_{n}(x)=y$,
        \item[(2)] $d^{p}_{m}(x)=z$,
        \item[(3)] the differential in (1) or the differential in (2) has no crossing,
        \item[(4)] $d^{g}_{l}(z)=w$, and has no crossing.
    \end{enumerate}
    Then $d^{q}_{m+l-n}(y)=w$.
\par\href{paper/diagrams/2.15.html}{Original diagrams and hypotheses}

private theorem square_frames
    {Z W : Syn}
    {cz : SyntheticTowerConvergence P Z} {cw : SyntheticTowerConvergence P W}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {h : X ⟶ Z} {j : Z ⟶ W} {k : Y ⟶ W}
    (Mf : ConvergentMap E f cx.toConvergence cy.toConvergence)
    (Mh : ConvergentMap E h cx.toConvergence cz.toConvergence)
    (Mj : ConvergentMap E j cz.toConvergence cw.toConvergence)
    (hcomm : f ≫ k = h ≫ j)
    (p : ℤ × ℤ) (s n m l : ℤ)
    (x : ((E.obj X).sequence.ssData (s,p.1+s,p.2)).eInfty)
    (y : ((E.obj Y).sequence.ssData (s+n,p.1+(s+n),p.2)).eInfty)
    (z : ((E.obj Z).sequence.ssData (s+m,p.1+(s+m),p.2)).eInfty)
    (w : ((E.obj W).sequence.ssData (s+m+l,p.1+(s+m+l),p.2)).eInfty)
    (hf : TowerExtensionEquation Mf p s n x y)
    (hh : TowerExtensionEquation Mh p s m x z)
    (hj : TowerExtensionEquation Mj p (s+m) l z w)
    (hnc : TowerNoCrossing Mf p s n ∨ TowerNoCrossing Mh p s m)
    (hncj : TowerNoCrossing Mj p (s+m) l) :
    ∃ (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (cr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (dr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
      (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y ∧
      (P.filtration Z).toAssociatedGraded (s+m) p cr = (infinityGradedIso cz p (s+m)).hom z ∧
      (P.filtration W).toAssociatedGraded (s+m+l) p dr = (infinityGradedIso cw p (s+m+l)).hom w ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ∧
      ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr ≫ j = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr ∧
      ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ≫ k = ((P.filtration W).F (s+m+l) p).arrow dr := by
  have hthree : ∃ (ar : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration X).F s p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (br : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ))
      (cr : (Subobject.underlying.obj ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p) : ModuleCat.{v} ℤ)),
      (P.filtration X).toAssociatedGraded s p ar = (infinityGradedIso cx p s).hom x ∧
      (P.filtration Y).toAssociatedGraded (s+n) p br = (infinityGradedIso cy p (s+n)).hom y ∧
      (P.filtration Z).toAssociatedGraded (s+m) p cr = (infinityGradedIso cz p (s+m)).hom z ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ f = ((P.filtration Y).F (s+n) p).arrow br ∧
      ((P.filtration X).F s p).arrow ar ≫ h = ((P.filtration Z).F (s+m) p).arrow cr := by
    rcases hnc with hnf | hnh
    · obtain ⟨_,ar,cr,he,ha,hc⟩ := (tower_extension_iff Mh p s m x z).mp hh
      obtain ⟨br,he',hb⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mf p s n x y hf hnf ar ha
      exact ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,he',he⟩
    · obtain ⟨_,ar,br,he,ha,hb⟩ := (tower_extension_iff Mf p s n x y).mp hf
      obtain ⟨cr,he',hc⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mh p s m x z hh hnh ar ha
      exact ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,he,he'⟩
  obtain ⟨ar,br,cr,ha,hb,hc,haf,hah⟩ := hthree
  obtain ⟨dr,hcj,hd⟩ := tower_target_of_any_source_frame Mj p (s+m) l z w hj hncj cr hc
  refine ⟨ar,br,cr,dr,ha,hb,hc,hd,haf,hah,hcj,?_⟩
  rw [←haf,Category.assoc,hcomm,←Category.assoc,hah,hcj]

entries.title: Morphisms of extension spectral sequences
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 2.18.)


    Consider a homotopy commutative diagram of spectra
    $$\text{see the original commutative diagram}.$$
    Assume $\ESS{p}_0^{*,*}=\ESS{p}_r^{*,*}$ and $\ESS{q}_0^{*,*}=\ESS{q}_r^{*,*}$ for some $r\ge 0$. Then 
    $$(d^p_r, d^q_r): E_\infty^{*,*}(X)\oplus E_\infty^{*,*}(Y)\to E_\infty^{*,*}(Z)\oplus E_\infty^{*,*}(W)$$
    induces a map from the $f$-ESS to the $g$-ESS.

entries.label: paper:2.19
entries.title: Permanent cycles from a null composite
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 2.19.)


    If the composition $g\circ f$ of two maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ is trivial, and $d_n^f(x)=y$ for $x\in E_\infty^{s,t}(X)$ and $y\in E_\infty^{s+n,t+n}(Y)$, then $y$ is a permanent cycle in the $g$-ESS, i.e., we have
    $d^g_m(y)=0$ for all $m\ge 0$.

entries.label: paper:2.20
entries.title: Exactness and extension boundaries
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 2.20.)


    Suppose that the sequence of spectra
    $$X\fto{f}Y\fto{g}Z$$
    induces a sequence of homotopy groups
    $$\pi_*X\fto{\pi_*f}\pi_*Y\fto{\pi_*g}\pi_*Z$$
    that is exact in $\pi_*Y$. Then all permanent cycles in $E^{*,*}_\infty(Y)$ of the $g$-ESS are boundaries in the $f$-ESS.

entries.label: paper:4.2
entries.title: Extensions for $\lambda^n$ and $\rho$
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 4.2.)\par

 
The only nonzero differentials in the extension spectral sequences for the maps $\lambda^n$ and $\rho$ from Notation~\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1009}{original source} are the $d_0$'s:
$$d^{\lambda^n}_0=\lambda^n \ \text{and} \ d^{\rho}_0=\rho.$$ 
As a result, these $d_0$'s have no crossings.

AimPaper Proposition 4.2 for `0 < n < m < ∞`. The first two clauses
exclude every positive-length essential λ/ρ extension; the last two clauses
identify their length-zero equations with their actual E∞ maps; the final

entries.label: paper:4.6
entries.title: Boundary extensions from Adams differentials
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 4.6.)\par


    Suppose in the classical Adams spectral sequence of $X$ we have $d_r(x)=y$, where $x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X)$ and $y\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(X)$. Consider the map
    $$\delta:\nu X/\lambda^n\to \Sus^{1,-n}\nu X/\lambda^{m-n}.$$
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] If $r\ge n+1$, then we view $x$ as an element of 
        $$E_\infty^{s,t,t}(\nu X/\lambda^n)\iso Z_n^{s,t}(X),$$
        and $\lambda^{r-n-1} y$ as an element of 
        $$E_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1, t+n}(\nu X/\lambda^{m-n})\iso Z_{m-r+1}^{s+r,t+r-1}(X)/B_{r-n}^{s+r,t+r-1}(X).$$
        We then have
        $$d^{\delta}_r(x)=\lambda^{r-n-1}y,$$
        which is trivial if $r>m$.
        \item[(2)] If $r<n+1$, then we view $\lambda^{n+1-r}x$ as an element of 
        $$E_\infty^{s,t,t-n-1+r}(\nu X/\lambda^n)\iso Z^{s,t}_{r-1}(X)/B^{s,t}_{n+2-r}(X),$$
        and $y$ as an element of 
        $$E_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1, t+r-1}(\nu X)\iso Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(X).$$
        In this case, we have
        $$d^{\delta}_r(\lambda^{n+1-r}x)=y.$$
    \end{enumerate}

lean.code:
public theorem syntheticDeltaExtension_finite (X : ClassicalObject)
    (n m k a : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (ha : a≤n) (hnm : n<m) (hnk : n≤a+k) (s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model X (s+k+1,t+k))
    (hd : HasDifferential (model.classical.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary))
      (k+1) (s,t) (s+k+1,t+k) x y)
    (hy : y∈permanentCycles model X (s+k+1,t+k)) :
    ∃ ex ey,
      HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s,(t-s)+s,t-a)
        (syntheticDeltaSourceLabel X n s t a x) ex ∧
      HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a)
        (syntheticDeltaFiniteLabel X n m k a s t hnk y) ey ∧
      TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap (.quotient n (.nu X))
        (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X)))
        (syntheticFiniteBoundary X n m (by omega) hnm))
        (t-s,t-a) s (k+1) ex ey := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hδ⟩ := weighted_absolute_boundary_closed X n k a hn ha hnk s t x y hd hy
  have hb' := detects_transport (show (s,t,t-a)=(s,(t-s)+s,t-a) by simp) _ _ hb
  have hδ' := detects_transport
    (show (s+k+1,t+k,t-a+n)=(s+(k+1),(t-s)-1+(s+(k+1)),t-a+n) by ext <;> dsimp <;> omega)
    _ _ hδ
  have hδ' := boundary_detects_shifted (.nu X) n (t-s) (t-a) (s+(k+1)) b _ (by
    convert hδ' using 1
    simp only [SyntheticObject.obj,regrade_precomp,←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans])
  let g := (SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-(n:ℤ))).map
    (XModLambdaN.incl (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (m-n))
  have hδf := detects_map (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.nu X))
    (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X))) g
    (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a) _ _ hδ'
  have heval := finite_boundary_evaluation X n m (by omega) hnm (t-s) (t-a) b
  have hdetection : Detects (model.convergence (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X))))
      (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a) (syntheticDeltaFiniteLabel X n m k a s t hnk y)
      (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (b≫syntheticFiniteBoundary X n m (by omega) hnm)) := by
    rw [heval]
    convert hδf using 1
    · rfl
    · simp only [g,syntheticAbsoluteBoundary,absoluteBoundary,Operations.biSuspensionIso,
        SyntheticObject.obj,regrade_precomp,Category.assoc]
  exact extension_equation_of_detected_pair
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient n (.nu X))
      (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X)))
      (syntheticFiniteBoundary X n m (by omega) hnm))
    (t-s,t-a) s (k+1) (by omega) _ _ b
    (b≫syntheticFiniteBoundary X n m (by omega) hnm) hb' hdetection rfl

lean.code:
public theorem syntheticDeltaFiniteTarget_vanishes (X : ClassicalObject)
    (n m k a : ℕ) (hnm : n<m) (hout : m≤a+k) (s t : ℤ)
    (e : ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift (1,-(n:ℤ))
      (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X))).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a)).eInfty) : e=0 := by
  let B : SyntheticObject := .quotient (m-n) (.nu X)
  let δ : ℤ×ℤ := (1,-(n:ℤ))
  let p : ℤ×ℤ := (t-s-1,t-a+n)
  let v := s+(k+1)
  have hzero := finite_infinity_zero_outside X (m-n) (by omega) v (p.1+v) p.2 (by
    dsimp [v,p]
    omega)
  let I := towerInfinityIso (model.convergence B) (model.convergence (.shift δ B))
    ((essShift δ).filtered B p) v
  have hind : (v,(p+δ).1+v,(p+δ).2)=(s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a) := by
    ext <;> dsimp [v,p,δ] <;> omega
  let J := I ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg
    (fun j => ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift δ B).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData j).eInfty) hind)
  have hz : IsZero ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.shift δ B).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
      (s+(k+1),(t-s)+(s+(k+1)),t-a)).eInfty :=
    hzero.of_iso J.symm
  exact (ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hz).elim _ _

      (.quotient (m-n) (.nu X))).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData

  have hδ' := detects_transport
    (show (s+k+1,t+k,t-a+n)=(s+(k+1),(t-s)-1+(s+(k+1)),t-a+n) by ext <;> dsimp <;> omega)
    _ _ hδ
  have hδ' := boundary_detects_shifted (.nu X) n (t-s) (t-a) (s+(k+1)) b _ (by
    convert hδ' using 1
    simp only [SyntheticObject.obj,regrade_precomp,←Category.assoc,eqToHom_trans])
  have he := extension_equation_of_detected_pair
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient n (.nu X)) (.shift (1,-(n:ℤ)) (.nu X))
      (syntheticAbsoluteBoundary X n)) (t-s,t-a) s (k+1) (by omega)
      (syntheticDeltaSourceLabel X n s t a x) _ b (b≫syntheticAbsoluteBoundary X n)
      (by exact hb') (by
          simpa only [syntheticAbsoluteBoundary, absoluteBoundary,Operations.biSuspensionIso,
            SyntheticObject.obj] using hδ') rfl
  exact he

entries.label: paper:4.14
entries.title: Crossings of Adams differentials
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Definition 4.14.)\par


    Suppose $r\ge n+1$ and $d_r(x)=y$, where
    $$x\in E_2^{s,t}(X), \hspace{0.5cm} y\in E_2^{s+r,t+r-1}(X).$$
    A crossing of $d_r(x)=y$ on the $E_{n+1}$-page refers to an essential Adams differential
    $$d_{r-a-b}(x^\prime)=y^\prime,$$
    where
    $$x^\prime\in E_2^{s+a,t+a}(X), \hspace{.5cm} y^\prime\in E_2^{s+r-b,t+r-b-1}(X),$$
    with $0<a\le n-1$ and $0\le b\le r-n-1$. See Figure \href{paper/main.tex.html#L1211}{original source}.

entries.label: paper:4.16
entries.title: Adams crossings and boundary-extension crossings
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 4.16.)\par


    The Adams differential $d_r(x)=y$ has a crossing on the $E_{n+1}$-page if and only if the corresponding $\delta_n$-extension
    $$d^{\delta_n}_r(x)=\lambda^{r-n-1}y$$
    for
    $$\delta_{n}:\nu X/\lambda^{n}\to \Sus^{1,-n}\nu X$$
    has a crossing.

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Paper.classical_crossing_iff_delta_crossing
lean.code:
public theorem classical_crossing_iff_delta_crossing
    (X : ClassicalObject) (page : ℕ) (r s t : ℤ)
    (hpage : 2 ≤ page) (hpr : (page:ℤ) ≤ r) :
    HasCrossingOn model X r page (s,t) ↔ DeltaHasCrossing X page r s t := by
  classical
  have hdef : DeltaHasCrossing X page r s t ↔
      ¬TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
        (.quotient (page-1) (.nu X)) (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu X))
        (absoluteBoundary (model.nu.functor.obj (X.obj model.auxiliary)) (page-1)))
        (t-s,t) s r := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u,v,hu,huv,hv,x,y,hess⟩ hn
      exact hn u v hu huv hv x y
        (by simpa only [Operations.biSuspensionIso,absoluteBoundary] using hess)
    · intro hn
      by_contra hnot
      apply hn
      intro u v hu huv hv x y hess
      apply hnot
      exact ⟨u,v,hu,huv,hv,x,y,
        by simpa only [Operations.biSuspensionIso,absoluteBoundary] using hess⟩
  rw [hdef]
  constructor
  · intro hcross hnc
    exact (delta_no_crossing_implies_classical X page r s t hpage hpr hnc).2.2 hcross
  · intro hcross
    by_contra hnc
    exact hcross (classical_noCrossing_absolute_boundary X page r s t ⟨by omega,hpr,hnc⟩)

entries.label: paper:5.4
entries.title: Extensions on the $E_r$-page
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Definition 5.4.)\par


    Let $x\in Z^{s,t}_{r-1}(X)$ and $y\in Z^{s+n,t+n}_{r-1-n+e(f)}(Y)$ for some 
    $$e(f)\le n\le r-2+e(f).$$
    We say that there is an $(f,E_r)$-extension from $x$ to $y$, denoted by
    \begin{equation}\label{eq:b98be76a}
    d_{n}^{f,E_r}(x)=y
    \end{equation}
    if there exists a synthetic $\hat f_{r-1}$-extension
    \begin{equation}\label{eq:a020bad3}
        d_{n}^{\hat f_{r-1}}(x)=\lambda^{n-e(f)} y.
    \end{equation}
    where $x$ is viewed as an element of the subgroup (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1290}{original source}) with $k=0$, and $\lambda^{n-e(f)} y$ is viewed as an element of the quotient group (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1294}{original source}) with $k=0$. 

   We say that this $(f,E_r)$-extension in (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1305}{original source}) is \emph{essential} if the corresponding synthetic $\hat f_{r-1}$-extension in (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1309}{original source}) is an essential differential in the $\hat f_{r-1}$-ESS.
    
    For $r=\infty$, we similar define an $(f,E_\infty)$-extension using the corresponding synthetic $\hat f$-extension.

entries.title: Crossings of $E_r$-extensions
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Definition 5.9.)\par


    A crossing of the $(f,E_r)$-extension $d_{n}^{f,E_r}(x)=y$ in (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1305}{original source}) is defined as an essential $(f, E_{r-a})$-extension from some $x'\in Z_{r-1-a}^{s+a,t+a}(X)$ to 
    $$y'\in Z_{r-1-n+b+e(f)}^{s+n-b,t+n-b}(Y)\backslash B_{1+n-b-e(f)}^{s+n-b,t+n-b}(Y)$$
    (where $\backslash$ denotes the difference of sets and it means that $y'$ should survive to the classical Adams $E_{r-n+b+e(f)}$ page while it should not be hit by an Adams differential of length at most $1+n-b-e(f)$) for $0<a \le r-2$ and $0\le b\le n-a-e(f)$. See Figure \href{paper/main.tex.html#L1512}{original source}.

private theorem finite_normalized_image_filtration (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (q i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) (hiq : i < q) (s t : ℤ)
    (a : BiHom (t-s) (t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      (XModLambdaN ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) q))
    (ha : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+i) a) :
    FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+i+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
      (a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q) := by
  let e : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
  let A := (extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let B := model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)
  let F := SyntheticCategory.biShift (Syn:=SyntheticSpectrum) (0,-(i:ℤ))
  let Ta := (model.quotients.tower A).triangle hi hiq
  let Tb := (model.quotients.tower B).triangle hi hiq
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := normalized_finite_source_division X e i q hi hiq (t-s) (t+e) (s+i)
    (by omega) a ha
  let c := b≫F.map (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-i))
  have hc : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower (s+i+e) c := by
    have h := shifted_quotient_bottom_filtration Y (q-i) (by omega) (-(i:ℤ)) (t-s) (t+e) c
    convert h using 1; omega
  have hcomm := (model.quotients.natural (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map).lambda_naturality hi hiq
  change F.map (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (q-i))≫Tb.lambdaMap =
    Ta.lambdaMap≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q at hcomm
  change b≫Ta.lambdaMap=a at hb
  have he : c≫Tb.lambdaMap=a≫finiteExtensionMap model X Y f q := by
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [Category.assoc,hcomm,←Category.assoc,hb]
  rw [←he]
  exact map_preserves_filtration (model.convergentMap (.shift (0,-(i:ℤ)) (.quotient (q-i) (.nu Y)))
    (.quotient q (.nu Y)) Tb.lambdaMap) (t-s,t+e) (s+i+e) c hc

entries.label: paper:6.1
entries.title: The generalized Leibniz rule
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Theorem 6.1.)\par

[Generalized Leibniz Rule]
    Let $f: X\to Y$ be a map between two classical spectra.
    Suppose that $2\le n\le r$, $e(f)\le m\le n-2+e(f)$, $l\ge e(f)$, and we have
    $$x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X), \hspace{0.5cm} y\in Z_{r-1-m+e(f)}^{s+m,t+m}(Y)$$
    $$x_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(X), \hspace{0.5cm} y_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r+l,t+r+l-1}(Y)$$
    and the following conditions hold:
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] $d_{r}(x)=x_\infty$,
        \item[(2)] $d_{m}^{f,E_n}(x)=y$,
        \item[(3)] $d_{l}^{f,E_\infty}(x_\infty)=y_\infty$,
        \item[(4)] the differential in (1) has no crossing on the $E_n$-page or (2) has no crossing.
        \item[(5)] the differential in (3) has no crossing.
    \end{enumerate}
    Then we have an Adams differential
    $$d_{r+l-m}(y)= y_\infty.$$

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Standard.generalizedLeibniz
lean.code:
public theorem generalizedLeibniz
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary) :
    GeneralizedLeibnizLaw model X Y f := by
  intro page r m l s t x y xInfinity yInfinity hpage hpr hm hmUpper hl
    hx hy hxInfinity hyInfinity hdx hf hfInfinity hsourceCrossing htargetCrossing
  let WFinite := Classical.choice hf
  let WInfinity := Classical.choice hfInfinity
  let LeftEdge : Prop := TowerExtensionEquation
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r WFinite.source
    (Internal.Leibniz.glBottomSource X Y f page r l s t hpage hpr WInfinity)
  let SourceNoCrossing : Prop :=
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r ∨
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (page-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s m
  let BottomNoCrossing : Prop := Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing
    (model.convergentMap
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu Y))
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ))).map (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+r) l
  have hsourceReady : SourceNoCrossing ∨ FiniteNoCrossing model X Y f page m s t := by
    rcases hsourceCrossing with hδcross | hfcross
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl
        (Internal.Leibniz.classical_noCrossing_shifted_absolute_boundary X page
          (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) r s t hδcross))
    · by_cases hmmin : m ≤ normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr
          (Internal.Leibniz.minimal_length_finite_tower_no_crossing X Y f
            (page-1) (by omega) s t m hmmin))
      · exact Or.inr hfcross
  have boundary_regrade (m0 m1 w0 w1 : ℤ) (hm0 : m0=m1) (hw0 : w0=w1)
      (a0 : BiHom m0 w0 (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) (page-1))) :
      Internal.Mahowald.biSuspensionHomEquiv m1 w1 (page-1:ℕ) _

public def GeneralizedLeibnizLaw (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ (page : ℕ) (r m l s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient D X (s, t)) (y : Ambient D Y (s + m, t + m))
    (xInfinity : Ambient D X (s + r, t + r - 1))
    (yInfinity : Ambient D Y (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l)),
    2 ≤ page → (page : ℤ) ≤ r →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ m →
    m ≤ (page : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f →
    (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f : ℤ) ≤ l →
    IsCycle D X (r - 1) (s, t) x →
    IsCycle D Y (r - 1 - m + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower f) (s + m, t + m) y →
    IsPermanent D X (s + r, t + r - 1) xInfinity →
    IsPermanent D Y (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l) yInfinity →
    DifferentialAt D X r (s, t) (s + r, t + r - 1) x xInfinity →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f page m s t x y →
    InfiniteExtension D X Y f l (s + r) (t + r - 1) xInfinity yInfinity →
    (NoCrossingOn D X r page (s, t) ∨
      FiniteNoCrossing D X Y f page m s t) →
    InfiniteNoCrossing D X Y f l (s + r) (t + r - 1) →
    DifferentialAt D Y (r + l - m) (s + m, t + m)
      (s + r + l, t + r - 1 + l) y yInfinity

entries.title: The generalized Mahowald trick
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Theorem 6.12.)\par

[Generalized Mahowald Trick] 
    Consider a distinguished triangle of spectra
    $$X\fto{f} Y\fto{g} Z\fto{h} \Sus X$$
    with $e(f)+e(g)+e(h)=1$.
    Suppose that $r=n+m+l$, $n_1=n-e(f)\ge 1$, $m_1=m-e(g)\ge 0$, $l_1=l-e(h)\ge 0$, and
    $$\begin{array}{ll}
        x\in Z_{n_1}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X), & y\in Z_{m_1+1}^{s+n+l,t+n+l-1}(Y),\\
        \bar x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(Z), & \bar y\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(Z),
    \end{array}$$
    such that
    \begin{enumerate}
        \item[(1)] $d^{h,E_{r'}}_{l}\bar x=x$, where $r'=r-m_1=n_1+l_1+1$,
        \item[(2)] $d_r \bar x=\bar y$,
            \item[(3)] the $(h,E_{r'})$-extension in (1) has no crossing, or the Adams differential (2) has no crossing on the $E_{r'}$-page,
        \item[(4)] $d^{g,E_{m_1+2}}_{m}y=\bar y$.
    \end{enumerate}
    Then we have $x\in Z_{n+m+e(h)}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X)$ and
    $$d^{f,E_{n+m+1+e(h)}}_{n}x\equiv y \mod B_{r'}^{s+n+l,t+n+l-1}(Y).$$
    (See Figure \href{paper/main.tex.html#L1845}{original source}.)

public def GeneralizedMahowaldLaw (T : TriangleData D.auxiliary) : Prop :=
  ∀ he : (normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.f : ℤ) + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.g +
      normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h = 1,
  KIP126.Literature.NormalizedTriangleCompatible D T he →
  ∀ (n m l s t : ℤ),
    let r := n + m + l
    let n₁ := n - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.f
    let m₁ := m - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.g
    let l₁ := l - normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h
    let r' := r - m₁
    ∀ (x : Ambient D (T.X) (s + l, t + l - 1))
      (y : Ambient D (T.Y) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n))
      (xBar : Ambient D (T.Z) (s, t))
      (yBar : Ambient D (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m))
      (suspendedX : Ambient D (.shift 1 T.X) (s + l, t + l)),
      1 ≤ n₁ → 0 ≤ m₁ → 0 ≤ l₁ →
      IsCycle D (T.X) n₁ (s + l, t + l - 1) x →
      IsCycle D (T.Y) (m₁ + 1) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n) y →
      IsCycle D (T.Z) (r - 1) (s, t) xBar →
      IsPermanent D (T.Z) (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) yBar →
      (D.classicalSuspension T.X).DesuspendsClass (s + l) (t + l) suspendedX x →
      FiniteExtension D T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t xBar suspendedX →
      DifferentialAt D (T.Z) r (s, t)
        (s + l + n + m, t + l - 1 + n + m) xBar yBar →
      (FiniteNoCrossing D T.Z (.shift 1 T.X) T.h r'.toNat l s t ∨
        NoCrossingOn D (T.Z) r r' (s, t)) →
      FiniteExtension D T.Y T.Z T.g (m₁ + 2).toNat m (s + l + n) (t + l - 1 + n) y yBar →
      IsCycle D (T.X) (n + m + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h) (s + l, t + l - 1) x ∧
        ∃ y' : Ambient D (T.Y) (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n),
          FiniteExtension D T.X T.Y T.f (n + m + 1 + normalizedExponent D.classicalTower T.h).toNat
            n (s + l) (t + l - 1) x y' ∧
          Congruent D (T.Y) r' (s + l + n, t + l - 1 + n) y' y

第二个 no-crossing 分支属于 Z 上的 d_r，在 E_r′ 页检查；不属于 g。
h 的 target 位于 ΣX，其标签通过 D.classicalSuspension 的实际 tower/layer 图和 raw-cycle
商代表元与 x 关联。该比较的构造证明尚未交付，不能以任意 E₂ 等价代替。
结论是存在同余于 y 的真实 f-extension target，模实际 B_r′；不是自由
选取的 fTarget 操作。r′ 及结论页的正性由指数和与三个长度界保证。

public theorem generalizedMahowald
    (T : TriangleData model.auxiliary) :
    GeneralizedMahowaldLaw model T := by
  intro he htriangle n m l s t
  dsimp only
  intro x y xBar yBar suspendedX hn hm hl
    hx hy hxBar hyBar hsusp hh hd hcross hg
  let eg : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g
  let ef : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f
  let eh : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h
  let pg : ℕ := (m-eg+2).toNat
  let q : ℕ := pg-1
  let i : ℕ := (n+l+eg-1).toNat
  let Q : ℕ := (n+m+eh).toNat
  let sf : ℤ := s+l
  let tf : ℤ := t+l-1
  have hpg : 2 ≤ pg := by dsimp [pg,eg]; omega
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hqZ : (q:ℤ)=m-eg+1 := by dsimp [q,pg]; omega
  have hi : 0 < i := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hiZ : (i:ℤ)=n+l+eg-1 := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQZ : (Q:ℤ)=n+m+eh := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by have := Nat.zero_le (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f); omega
  have hnf : ef ≤ n := by dsimp [ef]; omega
  let Wg : FiniteExtensionWitness model T.Y T.Z T.g pg m (sf+n) (tf+n) y yBar :=
    Classical.choice hg
  let Zν := model.nu.functor.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)
  let boundary (aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i)) :
      BiHom ((tf+n)-(sf+n)) (tf+n+eg) (XModLambdaN Zν q) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega) (by dsimp [tf]; omega)
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN Zν q)
        (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
          (aZ ≫ ((model.quotients.tower Zν).triangle hi (show i < i + q by omega)).delta)))
  have boundary_representative :
      ∃ aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
          (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) aZ ∧
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu T.Z)))
          (sf+n+m,((tf+n)-(sf+n))+(sf+n+m),tf+n+eg)
          (finiteTargetForExtension model T.Y T.Z T.g q m (sf+n) (tf+n) Wg.length_lower yBar)
          (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (boundary aZ)) ∧
        (NoCrossingOn model T.Z (n+m+l) (n+m+l-(m-eg)) (s,t) →
          ∀ a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
            Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
              (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) a →
            boundary a = boundary aZ) := by
    have hmi : eg ≤ m := by dsimp [eg]; omega
    have hxi : xBar ∈ cycles model T.Z (i:ℤ) (s,t) :=
      cycles_antitone model T.Z (s,t) (by omega : (i:ℤ) ≤ n+m+l-1) hxBar.2
    have hxiR : ReachesPage (model.classical.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+1) (s,t) xBar :=
      (isCycle_iff_reaches model T.Z (i+1) (by omega) (s,t) xBar).mp
        ⟨by omega, by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hxi⟩
    obtain ⟨a0Zero,ha0Zero⟩ := (KIP126.Literature.Standard.bhs_finite_lift T.Z i hi s t xBar).mp hxiR
    let a0 : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i) :=
      a0Zero ≫ XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) i
    have ha0first : a0 ≫ (model.quotients.tower Zν).rho 1 i hi =
        firstLabel model T.Z s t xBar ≫
          XModLambdaN.map (SyntheticCategory.biShift_zero.hom.app Zν) 1 := by
      dsimp only [a0]
  -- … (truncated)

entries.title: Restriction of extensions to earlier pages
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 6.20.)\par


    Suppose that we have an $(f,E_r)$-extension $d^{f,E_r}_n(x)=y$, where $x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X)$ and $y\in Z_{r-1-n+e(f)}^{s+n,t+n}(Y)$. Then for all $2\le r'<r$, we also have
    \begin{equation}\label{eq:dr'}
        d^{f,E_{r'}}_n(x)=y.
    \end{equation}

    Furthermore, if $d^{f,E_r}_n(x)=y$ is essential and $n\le r'-2+e(f)$, then (\href{paper/main.tex.html#L1983}{original source}) is inessential if and only if there exists some $0<a'\le n-e(f)$ and an element
    $$x'\in Z_{r'-1-a'}^{s+a',t+a'}(X)\backslash Z_{r-1-a'}^{s+a',t+a'}(X)$$
    such that
    $$d^{\hat f_{r'-1}}_{n-a'-b}(\lambda^{a'} x')=\lambda^{n-b-e(f)} y'$$
    for some $b\ge 0$.

lean.code:
public theorem finiteExtension_inessential_iff_shorter (X Y : ClassicalObject)
    (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ) (x y)
    (Wlater : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rLater n s t x y)
    (Wearly : FiniteExtensionWitness model X Y f rEarlier n s t x y)
    (hle : rEarlier ≤ rLater) (hess : Wlater.Essential) :
    ¬ Wearly.Essential ↔ ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧
      (a:ℤ) ≤ n-normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f ∧
      ∃ x' : Ambient model X (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)),
        x' ∈ cycles model X (((rEarlier-1:ℕ):ℤ)- (a:ℤ)) (s+a,(t-s)+(s+a)) ∧
        ∃ z,
          HasInfinityRepresentative _ 2 _
            (finiteExtensionCorrectionLabel X Y f (rEarlier-1) s t a x') z ∧
          TowerExtensionEquation (model.convergentMap
            (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
            (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1)))
            (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+a) (n-a) z
            ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun d =>
              ((model.family.obj ((SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)).obj
                model.nu model.auxiliary)).sequence.ssData
                (d,(t-s)+d,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)).eInfty)
              (show s+n = (s+a)+(n-a) by omega))) Wearly.target) := by
  let A := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj
    model.nu model.auxiliary
  let B := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
  let M := model.convergentMap
    (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
    (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1))
  have hy := earlier_target_nonzero X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t x y Wlater Wearly hle hess
  constructor
  · intro hne
    have hn := inessential_length_strict X Y f rEarlier n s t x y Wearly hy hne
    have hq : 1 < rEarlier-1 := by have := Wearly.length_upper; omega
    obtain ⟨hn0,ar,br,heq,hbr⟩ :=
      (tower_inessential_iff_higher_source_same_target M p s n
        Wearly.source Wearly.target Wearly.equation).mp hne
    let I := infinityGradedIso (model.convergence
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))) p (s+1)
    let z := I.inv ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).toAssociatedGraded (s+1) p ar)
    obtain ⟨x',hx',hz⟩ := correction_label_exists X Y f (rEarlier-1)
      (by omega) s t 1 hq z
    refine ⟨1,by decide,by omega,x',hx',z,hz,?_⟩
    apply (tower_extension_reindexed M p (s+1) (n-1) (s+n) (by omega) z Wearly.target).mpr
    refine ⟨by omega,ar,br,heq,?_,hbr⟩
    exact (I.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).symm
  · rintro ⟨a,ha,han,x',hx',z,hz,he⟩
    obtain ⟨_,ar,br,heq,_,hbr⟩ :=
      (tower_extension_reindexed M p (s+a) (n-a) (s+n) (by omega) z Wearly.target).mp he
    have hα : ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p).arrow ar ∈
        model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule A (s+a) p := by
      have hm : ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p).arrow ar ∈
          ModuleCat.subobjectModule _ ((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p) := ⟨ar,rfl⟩
      simpa only [SyntheticTowerPresentation.filtration,OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using hm
    have hα' := model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone A p
      (show s+1 ≤ s+a by omega) hα
    obtain ⟨ar',har'⟩ := filtration_representative_exists model.syntheticTower A p (s+1)
      (((model.syntheticTower.filtration A).F (s+a) p).arrow ar) hα'
    apply (tower_inessential_iff_higher_source_same_target M p s n
      Wearly.source Wearly.target Wearly.equation).mpr
  -- … (truncated)

public theorem finiteExtension_descends
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary)
    (rEarlier rLater : ℕ) (n s t : ℤ)
    (x : Ambient model X (s,t)) (y : Ambient model Y (s+n,t+n))
    (hr : 2 ≤ rEarlier) (hle : rEarlier ≤ rLater)
    (hnUpper : n ≤ (rEarlier : ℤ) - 2 + normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
    (h : FiniteExtension model X Y f rLater n s t x y) :
    FiniteExtension model X Y f rEarlier n s t x y := by
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := h
  let ra := (model.quotients.tower
    ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).rho
      (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)
  let rb := (model.quotients.tower (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary))).rho
    (rEarlier-1) (rLater-1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)
  refine ⟨{
    page_ge_two := hr
    length_lower := W.length_lower
    length_upper := hnUpper
    source_cycle := reaches_earlier (by omega) (by omega) W.source_cycle
    target_cycle := reaches_earlier (by omega) (by omega) W.target_cycle
    source := (model.family.functor.map ra).eInftyMap
      (s,(t-s)+s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) W.source
    target := (model.family.functor.map rb).eInftyMap
      (s+n,(t-s)+(s+n),t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) W.target
    source_rep := ?_
    target_rep := ?_
    equation := ?_ }⟩
  · have hh := family_infinity_representative_map ra _ _ W.source W.source_rep
    rw [finite_source_rho] at hh
    exact hh
  · have hh := family_infinity_representative_map rb _ _ W.target W.target_rep
    rw [finite_target_rho] at hh
    exact hh
  · exact extension_square_map
      (.quotient (rLater-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rLater-1) (.nu Y))
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y))
      (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rLater-1))
      (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier-1)) ra rb
      ((model.quotients.natural (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map).rho_naturality
        (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s n W.source W.target W.equation

entries.title: Lifting extensions to later pages
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 6.23.)\par


    Suppose $r\ge r'$ and there exists an $(f,E_{r'})$-extension 
    $$d^{f,E_{r'}}_n(x)=y$$
    for $x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X)$ and $y\in Z_{r'-1-n+e(f)}^{s+n,t+n}(Y)$. Assume that this extension has no crossing of the form $d^{f,E_{r'-a}}_{n-a-b}(x')=y'$ for any $b>0$, $0<a\le n-e(f)$, and 
    $$x'\in Z_{r'-1-a}^{s+a,t+a}(X)\backslash Z_{r-1-a}^{s+a,t+a}(X).$$ 
    Under these conditions, we also have an $(f,E_{r})$-extension
    $$d^{f,E_{r}}_n(x)=y.$$

lean.name: KIP126.ProofTools.Standard.finitePageExtensionStretching
lean.code:
public theorem finitePageExtensionStretching
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary) :
    FinitePageExtensionStretchingLaw model X Y f := by
  classical
  intro rEarlier rLater n s t x y hr hle hn hnUpper hx hy hW hcross
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)) hn
  let p : ℤ × ℤ := (t - s, t + normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f)
  let Aearly := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier - 1)
    (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let Alater := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rLater - 1)
    (extensionSourceObject model X Y f)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let Bearly := (SyntheticObject.quotient (rEarlier - 1) (.nu Y)).obj model.nu model.auxiliary
  let E : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly) :=
    fun k => (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule Aearly k p).toAddSubgroup
  let L : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 Alater) :=
    fun k => (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule Alater k p).toAddSubgroup
  let F : ℤ → AddSubgroup (BiHom p.1 p.2 Bearly) :=
    fun k => (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule Bearly k p).toAddSubgroup
  let T := F (s + n + 1)
  let ρ : BiHom p.1 p.2 Alater →+ BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly :=
    (syntheticHomotopyMap
      ((model.quotients.tower ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary)).rho
        (rEarlier - 1) (rLater - 1) (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hle 1)) p).hom.toAddMonoidHom
  let g : BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly →+ BiHom p.1 p.2 Bearly :=
    (syntheticHomotopyMap (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier - 1)) p).hom.toAddMonoidHom
  have hL : Antitone L := by
    intro i j hij z hz
    exact model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone Alater p hij hz
  have actual_map_preserves (A B : SyntheticObject)
      (h : A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary ⟶ B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (k : ℤ)
      (z : BiHom p.1 p.2 (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary))
      (hz : z ∈ model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule (A.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) k p) :
      z ≫ h ∈ model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule (B.obj model.nu model.auxiliary) k p :=
    map_preserves_filtration (model.convergentMap A B h) p k z hz
  have hg : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ δ : BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly, δ ∈ E k → g δ ∈ F k := by
    intro k δ hδ
    exact actual_map_preserves (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (rEarlier-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (rEarlier - 1)) k δ hδ
  have hstep : ∀ k : ℤ, s + 1 ≤ k → k < s + 1 + n.toNat →
      ∀ δ : BiHom p.1 p.2 Aearly, δ ∈ E k →
      (∃ ε : BiHom p.1 p.2 Alater, ε ∈ L k ∧ δ - ρ ε ∈ E (k + 1)) ∨ g δ ∈ T := by
    intro k hk hkn δ hδ
    by_cases hlift : ∃ ε : BiHom p.1 p.2 Alater, ε ∈ L k ∧ δ - ρ ε ∈ E (k + 1)
    · exact Or.inl hlift
    right
    by_contra hnot
    have hlast : k + ((s + n + 1 - k).toNat : ℤ) = s + n + 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨l, hkl, hln, hgl, hgnext⟩ := first_nonzero_filtration_grade F k
      (s + n + 1 - k).toNat (g δ) (hg k δ hδ) (by simpa only [hlast] using hnot)
    apply hcross

有限 stretching 的障碍候选，直接在同一个早期 λ 商的实际 ESS 中定义。
源和靶的 synthetic weight 固定为原 extension 的 `t + e(f)`，而源的
filtration 提高 `a`。源必须不在后期商到早期商的实际 `ρ` 所诱导的
`E∞` 映射像中；这与某个普通 Adams 代表元不属于后页 cycle 层不同。
允许 `b = 0` 及长度 `n - a - b = 0` 的 synthetic extension，包括
`e(f) = 1` 的情形。要求同商中实际 extension equation 的靶非零，不要求
essential 性，不换成较小 λ 商的 extension，也不额外施加普通 Adams
boundary 排除条件。排除这些候选强于仅排除 essential crossings；这是
修复后的充分条件，不声称与原普通 Adams 代表元谓词等价。

public def FinitePageExtensionStretchingLaw (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj D.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj D.auxiliary) : Prop :=

    ¬ FiniteExtensionNonliftableCrossing D X Y f rEarlier rLater n s t →
    FiniteExtension D X Y f rLater n s t x y

entries.title: Generalized Leibniz and Mahowald laws
entries.chapter: ProofTools — Representatives, extensions and comparison laws
entries.body:
(From \cite{LWX126}, Theorems 6.1 and 6.12.)\par
Work in the fixed classical and synthetic Adams model.
\begin{enumerate}
\item Let $X,Y$ be classical spectra and $f:X\to Y$, and put $e=e(f)$. For every $p\in\mathbb N$ and $r,m,l,s,t\in\mathbb Z$ with
\[2\leq p\leq r,\qquad e\leq m\leq p-2+e,\qquad e\leq l,\]
let
\[x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(X),\qquad y\in Z_{r-1-m+e}^{s+m,t+m}(Y),\]
\[x_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(X),\qquad y_\infty\in Z_\infty^{s+r+l,t+r+l-1}(Y).
\]
Suppose that
\[d_r(x)=x_\infty,\qquad d_m^{f,E_p}(x)=y,\qquad d_l^{f,E_\infty}(x_\infty)=y_\infty.
\]
Assume that the first differential has no crossing on page $p$ or that the finite extension has no crossing, and that the infinite extension has no crossing. Then
\[d_{r+l-m}(y)=y_\infty.
\]
Thus the generalized Leibniz law of \ref{sem:ProofTools:leibniz-law} holds for every $X,Y,f$.

\item Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ\xrightarrow h\Sigma X$ be a distinguished triangle with
\[e(f)+e(g)+e(h)=1,
\]
and assume that its normalized synthetic maps form a compatible triangle, as in \ref{sem:ProofTools:mahowald-law}. For every $n,m,l,s,t\in\mathbb Z$, put
\[n_1=n-e(f)\geq1,\quad m_1=m-e(g)\geq0,\quad l_1=l-e(h)\geq0,\quad r=n+m+l,\quad r'=r-m_1.
\]
Let
\[x\in Z_{n_1}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X),\qquad y\in Z_{m_1+1}^{s+l+n,t+l+n-1}(Y),\]
\[\bar x\in Z_{r-1}^{s,t}(Z),\qquad\bar y\in Z_\infty^{s+r,t+r-1}(Z).
\]
Let $\widetilde x\in E_2^{s+l,t+l}(\Sigma X)$ desuspend to $x$ under the classical tower suspension comparison. Suppose that
\[d_l^{h,E_{r'}}(\bar x)=\widetilde x,\qquad d_r(\bar x)=\bar y,\qquad d_m^{g,E_{m_1+2}}(y)=\bar y.
\]
Assume that the $h$-extension has no crossing or that the classical differential has no crossing on page $r'$. Then
\[x\in Z_{n+m+e(h)}^{s+l,t+l-1}(X)
\]
and there is $y'\in E_2^{s+l+n,t+l+n-1}(Y)$ such that
\[d_n^{f,E_{n+m+1+e(h)}}(x)=y',\qquad y'-y\in B_{r'}^{s+l+n,t+l+n-1}(Y).
\]
\end{enumerate}

lean.code:
public theorem generalizedLeibniz
    (X Y : ClassicalObject) (f : X.obj model.auxiliary ⟶ Y.obj model.auxiliary) :
    GeneralizedLeibnizLaw model X Y f := by
  intro page r m l s t x y xInfinity yInfinity hpage hpr hm hmUpper hl
    hx hy hxInfinity hyInfinity hdx hf hfInfinity hsourceCrossing htargetCrossing
  let WFinite := Classical.choice hf
  let WInfinity := Classical.choice hfInfinity
  let LeftEdge : Prop := TowerExtensionEquation
    (model.convergentMap (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r WFinite.source
    (Internal.Leibniz.glBottomSource X Y f page r l s t hpage hpr WInfinity)
  let SourceNoCrossing : Prop :=
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (Internal.Leibniz.absoluteBoundary
        ((extensionSourceObject model X Y f).obj model.nu model.auxiliary) (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s r ∨
    Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing (model.convergentMap
      (.quotient (page-1) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.quotient (page-1) (.nu Y)) (finiteExtensionMap model X Y f (page-1)))
      (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) s m
  let BottomNoCrossing : Prop := Internal.Leibniz.TowerNoCrossing
    (model.convergentMap
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (extensionSourceObject model X Y f))
      (.shift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) (.nu Y))
      ((SyntheticCategory.biShift (1,-((page-1:ℕ):ℤ))).map (model.normalizedMap X Y f).map))
    (t-s,t+normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) (s+r) l
  have hsourceReady : SourceNoCrossing ∨ FiniteNoCrossing model X Y f page m s t := by
    rcases hsourceCrossing with hδcross | hfcross
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl
        (Internal.Leibniz.classical_noCrossing_shifted_absolute_boundary X page
          (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) r s t hδcross))
    · by_cases hmmin : m ≤ normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr
          (Internal.Leibniz.minimal_length_finite_tower_no_crossing X Y f
            (page-1) (by omega) s t m hmmin))
      · exact Or.inr hfcross
  have boundary_regrade (m0 m1 w0 w1 : ℤ) (hm0 : m0=m1) (hw0 : w0=w1)
      (a0 : BiHom m0 w0 (XModLambdaN (model.nu.functor.obj (Y.obj model.auxiliary)) (page-1))) :
      Internal.Mahowald.biSuspensionHomEquiv m1 w1 (page-1:ℕ) _
        (homotopyRegrade hm0 hw0 a0 ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ (page-1)) =
      homotopyRegrade (congrArg (fun z => z-1) hm0) (congrArg (fun z : ℤ => z+((page-1:ℕ):ℤ)) hw0)
        (Internal.Mahowald.biSuspensionHomEquiv m0 w0 (page-1:ℕ) _
          (a0 ≫ XModLambdaN.proj _ (page-1))) := by
    subst m1; subst w1; rfl
  obtain ⟨hbottom,hbottomSource,hbottomTarget⟩ :=
    Internal.Leibniz.infinite_extension_lambda_boundary_shift X Y f
      (r-page).toNat (page-1) l (s+r) (t+r-1) xInfinity yInfinity WInfinity
  have hbottomPoint := Internal.Leibniz.gl_bottom_point page r s t
    (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f) hpage hpr
  have hR : 2 ≤ r + l - m := by omega
  have hy_later : IsCycle model Y (r + l - m - 1)
      (s + m, t + m) y := by
    by_cases hlmin : l = (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower f : ℤ)
    · convert hy using 1
      omega
  -- … (truncated)

public theorem generalizedMahowald
    (T : TriangleData model.auxiliary) :
    GeneralizedMahowaldLaw model T := by
  intro he htriangle n m l s t
  dsimp only
  intro x y xBar yBar suspendedX hn hm hl
    hx hy hxBar hyBar hsusp hh hd hcross hg
  let eg : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.g
  let ef : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f
  let eh : ℤ := normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.h
  let pg : ℕ := (m-eg+2).toNat
  let q : ℕ := pg-1
  let i : ℕ := (n+l+eg-1).toNat
  let Q : ℕ := (n+m+eh).toNat
  let sf : ℤ := s+l
  let tf : ℤ := t+l-1
  have hpg : 2 ≤ pg := by dsimp [pg,eg]; omega
  have hq : 0 < q := by dsimp [q]; omega
  have hqZ : (q:ℤ)=m-eg+1 := by dsimp [q,pg]; omega
  have hi : 0 < i := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hiZ : (i:ℤ)=n+l+eg-1 := by dsimp [i,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hQZ : (Q:ℤ)=n+m+eh := by dsimp [Q,eg,ef,eh] at *; omega
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by have := Nat.zero_le (normalizedExponent model.classicalTower T.f); omega
  have hnf : ef ≤ n := by dsimp [ef]; omega
  let Wg : FiniteExtensionWitness model T.Y T.Z T.g pg m (sf+n) (tf+n) y yBar :=
    Classical.choice hg
  let Zν := model.nu.functor.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)
  let boundary (aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i)) :
      BiHom ((tf+n)-(sf+n)) (tf+n+eg) (XModLambdaN Zν q) :=
    homotopyRegrade (by dsimp [tf,sf]; omega) (by dsimp [tf]; omega)
      (biSuspensionHomEquiv (t-s) t (i:ℤ) (XModLambdaN Zν q)
        (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
          (aZ ≫ ((model.quotients.tower Zν).triangle hi (show i < i + q by omega)).delta)))
  have boundary_representative :
      ∃ aZ : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
          (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) aZ ∧
        Detects (model.convergence (.quotient q (.nu T.Z)))
          (sf+n+m,((tf+n)-(sf+n))+(sf+n+m),tf+n+eg)
          (finiteTargetForExtension model T.Y T.Z T.g q m (sf+n) (tf+n) Wg.length_lower yBar)
          (homotopyRegrade (by dsimp; omega) rfl (boundary aZ)) ∧
        (NoCrossingOn model T.Z (n+m+l) (n+m+l-(m-eg)) (s,t) →
          ∀ a : BiHom (t-s) t (XModLambdaN Zν i),
            Detects (model.convergence (.quotient i (.nu T.Z))) (s,t,t)
              (regradeE2 (by simp) (finiteTargetLabel model T.Z i s t 0 xBar)) a →
            boundary a = boundary aZ) := by
    have hmi : eg ≤ m := by dsimp [eg]; omega
    have hxi : xBar ∈ cycles model T.Z (i:ℤ) (s,t) :=
      cycles_antitone model T.Z (s,t) (by omega : (i:ℤ) ≤ n+m+l-1) hxBar.2
    have hxiR : ReachesPage (model.classical.obj (T.Z.obj model.auxiliary)) (i+1) (s,t) xBar :=
      (isCycle_iff_reaches model T.Z (i+1) (by omega) (s,t) xBar).mp
        ⟨by omega, by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hxi⟩

entries.label: sem:Computation:incoming-control
entries.title: Incoming differentials to T
entries.chapter: AdamsCalculations --- Differentials and Survival
entries.body: If $T$ is hit, its incoming differential is either $d_6(W)=T$ or $d_{12}(h_6^2)=T$, as specified in Fact~\ref{paper:7.6}. Consequently no page $r\geq2$ other than $6$ or $12$ can hit $T$, and no differential from $x_{126,6}$ can have target $T$. The $d_6$ target of $W$ belongs to $\{0,T\}$.

lean.name: KIP126.Computation.Standard.table9
lean.code:
public theorem table9 (r : ℤ) (_hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    ¬ HasNonzeroDifferential model.classical.sphere r (6,132) (14,139) (atom .x_126_6) T := by
  intro hd
  have hp := congrArg Prod.fst hd.toHasDifferential.target_degree
  have hdeg : (6 : ℤ) + r = 14 := by
    simpa only [ClassicalAdamsFamily.sphere, ClassicalAdamsFamily.obj,
      model.classical.differentialDegree, Prod.mk_add_mk, Prod.fst] using hp
  rcases t_only_incoming r hd.hit_target with hh | hh
  · omega
  · omega
lean.statement:
public theorem table9 (r : ℤ) (_hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    ¬ HasNonzeroDifferential model.classical.sphere r (6,132) (14,139) (atom .x_126_6) T

entries.chapter: AdamsCalculations --- Differentials and Survival
entries.body:
The detector Adams spectral sequence satisfies
\[d_3(v_2^{16})=B_{19,114}\]
where $v_2^{16}$ and $B_{19,114}$ denote the images of the selected detector classes under the comparison.

    HasDifferential (model.classical.obj model.auxiliary.detector) 3 (16,112) (19,114)

      (detectorComparison 19 114 detector_beta_agrees._proof_1 detectorBetaGFour) := by
  rw [detector_v2_agrees, detector_beta_agrees]
  exact KIP126.Literature.Standard.detector_d3

entries.label: sem:Computation:table-claim-syntax
entries.title: Finite Adams claim records
entries.chapter: AdamsCalculations --- Differentials and Survival
entries.body:
(From \cite{LinProgram}, archived Adams calculation records.)\par
A claim row specifies a spectrum, source and target coordinate lists, a page $r$, and one of four predicates: a differential equation, reaching a finite page, a boundary bound, or the refutation of a differential equation. A valid row has $r\geq2$ and valid coordinates; an equation or refutation also requires $(s\prime,t\prime)=(s+r,t+r-1)$. Validity checks the record's syntax and degrees; the mathematical certification is stated separately.

entries.chapter: AdamsCalculations --- Differentials and Survival

(From \cite{LinProgram}, archived finite table results.)\par
Every row in the fixed claim list decodes successfully and satisfies its stated mathematical predicate: reaching a finite page, being a boundary by a page, an actual differential equation, or the negation of that equation. Each class in the staircase list admits a representative on page $1000$.

lean.name: KIP126.Computation.Table.Statement
lean.code:
public def Statement (c : Raw.Claim) : Prop :=
  ∃ x, decode c.spectrum c.s c.t c.x = some x ∧
    match c.kind with
    | .reaches => ReachesPage (sequence c.spectrum) c.r (c.s,c.t) x
    | .boundaryBy => IsBoundaryBy (sequence c.spectrum) c.r (c.s,c.t) x
    | .equation => ∃ y, decode c.spectrum c.ts c.tt c.y = some y ∧
        HasDifferential (sequence c.spectrum) c.r (c.s,c.t) (c.ts,c.tt) x y
    | .refutation => ∃ y, decode c.spectrum c.ts c.tt c.y = some y ∧
        ¬ HasDifferential (sequence c.spectrum) c.r (c.s,c.t) (c.ts,c.tt) x y

entries.title: The candidates after the first Adams differential
entries.chapter: AdamsCalculations --- Differentials and Survival
entries.body:
(Project candidate list from \cite{Adams60}, Thm. 4.6.1; \cite{LinExt4}, Thm. 1.3.)\par{}

An ordered pair $(i,j)$ is a second-line $d_2$ candidate if its standard product is among
\[

Interface scope notes are retained as native hgraph node comments; historical migration records are local archives.

Detailed original sources: [Adams58](https://doi.org/10.1007/BF02564578), Theorem 2.2(iii), p.~182, supplies multiplicative Leibniz. [Adams60](https://doi.org/10.2307/1970147), Theorem 4.6.1, pp.~99--100, supplies the secondary-operation relation whose Adams interpretation is d2(h_j)=h0 h_(j-1)^2 for j>=4; the modern d2 formula is an adaptation, not a verbatim statement of that theorem. [LinExt4](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.topol.2007.11.003), Theorems 1.2--1.3, pp.~460--461, supplies the products and relations on the first four lines. These are the primary ingredients for a derived calculation, not a literal theorem of Lin.

Independent source audit found (0,4) to be a counterexample to the earlier candidate list. The product is nonzero by [Adams60](https://doi.org/10.2307/1970147), Theorem 2.5.1(2), p.~45. Lin Theorem 1.3(1), at i=0, gives h0^2 h3^2=0, hence Leibniz gives d2(h0 h4)=0. Its later nonzero d3 is explicit in [IWX](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10240-023-00139-1), Table 6, p.~222. The user approved the correction: add (0,4), supply its separate nonzero d3 Literature interface, and add its exclusion branch in Main. The final permanent-survivor statement is unchanged, and the one additional upstream responsibility raises the total from 309 to 310. The corrected screening and source-to-fixed-model comparison remain a registered upstream proof obligation; citation verification and finite checks do not prove the unbounded interface.

\begin{enumerate}
   
    \item[(1)] $x_{126,8,4} + x_{126,8}$ survives to the $E_6$-page.

    \item[(3)] $h_0^2x_{124,8}$ survives to the $E_\infty$-page.

    \item[(4)] In $\Ext_A^{25,125+25}$, the element $g^4\Delta h_1g$ is the only one that survives to the classical $E_5$-page.
\end{enumerate}

entries.label: frontier:AdamsCalculations:f6a9ba54d96c
entries.title: Classification of every incoming differential to T
entries.chapter: AdamsCalculations --- Differentials and Survival
entries.body:
Let $r\in\mathbb Z$. If an $r$th-page differential hits a nonzero representative of $T\in E_2^{14,139}(S^0)$, then either
\[r=6\quad\hbox{and}\quad d_6(W)=T,\]
or
\[r=12\quad\hbox{and}\quad d_{12}(h_6^2)=T.\]
In either alternative, the displayed differential is nonzero. Its source bidegree is respectively $(8,134)$ or $(2,128)$.

entries.label: frontier:AdamsCalculations:cd5b5345e83c
entries.title: Incoming-hit restrictions and specified differentials
entries.chapter: AdamsCalculations --- Differentials and Survival
entries.body:
The following statements hold in the sphere Adams spectral sequence.
\begin{enumerate}
\item For every page $r\geq2$, no differential hits a nonzero $r$th-page representative of $V$.
\item For every page $r\geq2$, no differential hits a nonzero $r$th-page representative of $Y$.
\item Put $A=x_{123,11,2}+x_{123,11}+h_0h_6[B_4]$. The differential
\[d_7(A)=h_1x_{121,17}\]
is nonzero, in bidegrees $(11,134)\longrightarrow(18,140)$.
\item One of the two nonzero differentials
\[d_3(x_{126,6})=h_5x_{94,8},\qquad d_3(x_{126,6})=h_5x_{94,8}+h_6b\]
holds, in bidegrees $(6,132)\longrightarrow(9,134)$.
\item $d_3(x_{126,4})=h_0^2x_{125,5}$ is nonzero, in bidegrees $(4,130)\longrightarrow(7,132)$.
\item $d_3(h_0^2x_{123,13,2})=h_0^2x_{122,16}$ is nonzero, in bidegrees $(15,138)\longrightarrow(18,140)$.
\item $d_2(h_0^6h_6)=h_0b$ is nonzero, in bidegrees $(7,70)\longrightarrow(9,71)$.
\end{enumerate}

entries.label: frontier:AdamsCalculations:7621dd387a1a
entries.title: Permanent classes and cofiber survival
entries.chapter: AdamsCalculations --- Differentials and Survival
entries.body:
The following statements hold in the sphere and nu-cofiber Adams spectral sequences.
\begin{enumerate}
\item $i_*T\in E_2^{14,139}(C\nu)$ has a nonzero representative on page $6$.
\item $Q\in E_2^{12,134}$ has a nonzero infinite-page representative.
\item $Ph_2\in E_2^{12,137}$ is a boundary by page $2$.
\item $P\in E_2^{11,133}$ has a nonzero infinite-page representative.
\item $Qh_2\in E_2^{13,138}$ is a boundary by page $2$.
\item No differential on a page $2\leq r\leq5$ hits a nonzero representative of $i_*T$ in the $C\nu$ spectral sequence.
\end{enumerate}

entries.label: sem:Main:two-line-classification-goal
entries.title: The exact second-line classification proposition
entries.chapter: Main — The permanence argument
entries.body:
\textit{(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 1.5.)}
For $x\in E_2^{2,t}$, let $L(t,x)$ mean that $x$ equals one of
\[
 h_0h_2,\quad h_0h_3,\quad h_2h_4,\quad h_1h_j\ (j\geq3),\quad h_j^2\ (0\leq j\leq6).
\]
Each equality includes its bidegree equation and transport in the actual sphere $E_2$ module. Define the proposition $C$ by
\[
 C\;:\!\Longleftrightarrow\;\forall t\in\mathbb Z\ \forall x\in E_2^{2,t},\quad
 x\text{ survives nontrivially to }E_\infty\ \Longleftrightarrow\ L(t,x).
\]
This entry defines the target; it does not prove $C$.

entries.label: sem:Main:remark-7.4
entries.title: Remark 7.4: normalization of the finite-quotient criterion
entries.chapter: Main — The permanence argument
entries.body:
\textit{(From \cite{LWX126}, Remark 7.4.)}
Let $q_n$ denote the quotient map to $S^{0,0}/\lambda^n$. For every $a\in\pi_{125,130}S^{0,0}$ and $n\geq0$,
\[
 q_n(a)=0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad q_{n+1}(\lambda a)=0.
\]
In particular, with $a=\eta(\theta_5^{\mathrm{BX}})^2$ this identifies the two quotient conditions
\[
 q_r\bigl(\eta(\theta_5^{\mathrm{BX}})^2\bigr)=0
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 q_{r+1}\bigl(\lambda\eta(\theta_5^{\mathrm{BX}})^2\bigr)=0.
\]
\par\emph{Proof.} Exactness of the lambda cofiber sequence identifies $\ker q_n$ with the image of $\lambda^n$. Multiplication by $\lambda$ is injective on $\pi_{125,130}S^{0,0}$ in the fixed system. Thus $\lambda a=\lambda^{n+1}b$ is equivalent to $a=\lambda^n b$. Specializing $a$ gives the change of quotient convention used in \ref{paper:7.3}.



\href{paper/main.tex.html#L2127}{Original remark}.

lean.code:
public theorem normalized_quotient (n : ℕ)
    (a : BiHom 125 130 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum)) :
    quotientClass n a = 0 ↔ quotientClass (n+1) (lambdaMultiply 1 a) = 0 := by
  exact Internal.Choice.Completion.normalized_quotient n a
lean.docstring:
LWX Remark 7.4: the two finite-quotient vanishing conditions agree
in the fixed bidegree. This includes the zero-length quotient.

entries.label: sem:Main:remark-7.5
entries.title: Remark 7.5: independence of the theta choice
entries.chapter: Main — The permanence argument
entries.body:
\textit{(From \cite{LWX126}, Remark 7.5.)}
For every $\theta\in\pi_{62,64}S^{0,0}$ satisfying $\operatorname{ThetaChoice}(\theta)$,
\[
 \lambda\eta\theta^2=\lambda\eta(\theta_5^{\mathrm{BX}})^2.
\]
In particular, this expression has the same value for any two admissible choices. It is the expression, rather than $\theta$ itself, that is independent of the choice.
\par\emph{Proof.} The stem-62 choice comparison places $\theta-\theta_5^{\mathrm{BX}}$ in filtration at least six. The exponent-two square identity therefore puts $\theta^2-(\theta_5^{\mathrm{BX}})^2$ in filtration at least twelve. The established eta-error estimate raises the filtration of its eta multiple to at least fifteen. This eta-product difference is annihilated by two and has zero detector image, so the established filtration-fifteen detection theorem makes it zero. Multiplying by $\lambda$ gives the claimed equality.



\href{paper/main.tex.html#L2133}{Original remark}.

public theorem lambda_eta_theta_square_independent
    (theta : BiHom 62 64 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum)) (htheta : ThetaChoice theta) :
    KIP126.Literature.Standard.lambdaEtaThetaSquare theta =
      KIP126.Literature.Standard.lambdaEtaThetaSquare
        KIP126.Literature.Standard.bxTheta5 := by
  classical
  let theta' := KIP126.Literature.Standard.bxTheta5
  have hgap := Internal.Choice.theta_choice_filtration_gap_of_pages
    Internal.Choice.theta_choice_finite_pages theta theta' htheta
    KIP126.Literature.Standard.bx_theta_label
  have hsquare : FiltrationAtLeast model.syntheticTower 12
      (sphereProduct theta theta - sphereProduct theta' theta') := by
    rw [Internal.Choice.theta_square_difference theta theta'
      KIP126.Literature.Standard.bx_order_two]
    exact KIP126.Literature.Standard.action_filtration .sphere 62 64 62 64 6 6
      (theta-theta') (theta-theta') hgap hgap
  have herror := Internal.Selected.eta_weight128_branches_filtration_fifteen _
    (Internal.Selected.stem124_weight128_filtration11_branches
      (Internal.Selected.theta_sphere_frame 13 137 9 (by decide) (by decide) _
        Internal.Selected.correction_infinity_generated) _
      (model.syntheticTower.filtrationSubmodule_antitone _ (124,128)
        (by decide : (11:ℤ) ≤ 12) hsquare))
  have hlinear : sphereProduct KIP126.Literature.Standard.eta
      (sphereProduct theta theta - sphereProduct theta' theta') =
      sphereProduct KIP126.Literature.Standard.eta (sphereProduct theta theta) -
        sphereProduct KIP126.Literature.Standard.eta (sphereProduct theta' theta') := by
    simp only [sphereProduct, Int.reduceAdd, CategoryTheory.Preadditive.comp_sub]
  rw [hlinear] at herror
  have heq := Internal.High125.detector_injective_filtration15 _ herror
    (Internal.High125.eta_product_difference_order_two 124 128
      (sphereProduct theta theta) (sphereProduct theta' theta')) (by
    rw [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.sub_comp,
      Internal.High125.synthetic_eta_theta_square_detector_zero theta,
      Internal.High125.synthetic_eta_theta_square_detector_zero theta', sub_self])
  have h := congrArg (lambdaMultiply 1) (sub_eq_zero.mp heq)
  exact h

entries.label: sem:Main:boundary-formula
entries.title: The total boundary at every theta choice
entries.chapter: Main — The permanence argument
entries.body:
\textit{(From \cite{LWX126}, Remark 7.5.)}
For every admissible $\theta\in\pi_{62,64}S^{0,0}$, the total boundary of the first-quotient class $h_6^2$ satisfies
\[
 \delta_1(h_6^2)=\lambda\eta\theta^2.
\]
Here $\delta_1$ is the connecting map for the first lambda quotient. In particular, $\lambda\eta\theta^2$ is independent of the admissible theta choice.
\par\emph{Proof.} Literature gives the boundary formula at $\theta_5^{\mathrm{BX}}$; \ref{sem:Main:remark-7.5} identifies its right-hand side with the expression at $\theta$.

entries.label: sem:Main:any-choice-criterion
entries.title: Normalization and choice transport of the literature criterion
entries.chapter: Main — The permanence argument
entries.body:
\textit{(From \cite{LWX126}, Theorem 7.3 and Remarks 7.4--7.5; \cite{BurklundXu}, Proposition 7.19.)}
The literature criterion is recalled in \ref{paper:7.3}. On the fixed system its normalized form is as follows.
For every admissible $\theta$ and every natural number $r\geq0$,
\[
 h_6^2\text{ survives to }E_{r+3}
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 [\lambda\eta\theta^2]=0\text{ in }S^{0,0}/\lambda^{r+1}.
\]
Moreover,
\[
 P\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\lambda\eta\theta^2=0
 \text{ in the untruncated synthetic sphere}.
\]
\par\emph{Proof.} For $r\geq1$, apply the distinguished-choice literature criterion and then combine \ref{sem:Main:remark-7.4} with \ref{sem:Main:remark-7.5}. At $r=0$, $h_6^2$ survives to $E_3$ and every lambda multiple maps to zero in $S^{0,0}/\lambda$. The untruncated equivalence is the distinguished-choice literature criterion followed by \ref{sem:Main:remark-7.5}.

lean.name: KIP126.Main.any_choice_criterion
lean.code:
public theorem any_choice_criterion
    (theta : BiHom 62 64 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum)) (htheta : ThetaChoice theta) :
    (∀ r : ℕ,
      (SurvivesTo model.classical.sphere ((r : ℤ)+3) (2,128)
        model.standardClasses.standardH6Square ↔
        quotientClass (r+1) (KIP126.Literature.Standard.lambdaEtaThetaSquare theta) = 0)) ∧
    (H6SquarePermanent ↔ KIP126.Literature.Standard.lambdaEtaThetaSquare theta = 0) := by
  have he := lambda_eta_theta_square_independent theta htheta
  constructor
  · intro r
    cases r with
    | zero =>
      exact ⟨fun _ => lambda_eta_theta_square_mod_lambda_zero theta,
        fun _ => h6_square_survives_three⟩
    | succ r =>
      rw [he]
      exact normalized_bx_finite (r+1) (by omega)
  · rw [he]
    exact KIP126.Literature.Standard.bx_untruncated
lean.statement:
public theorem any_choice_criterion
    (theta : BiHom 62 64 (S_0_0 : SyntheticSpectrum)) (htheta : ThetaChoice theta) :
    (∀ r : ℕ,
      (SurvivesTo model.classical.sphere ((r : ℤ)+3) (2,128)
        model.standardClasses.standardH6Square ↔
        quotientClass (r+1) (KIP126.Literature.Standard.lambdaEtaThetaSquare theta) = 0)) ∧
    (H6SquarePermanent ↔ KIP126.Literature.Standard.lambdaEtaThetaSquare theta = 0)

Let $x\in E_2^{s,t}$ and let $k\geq0$. For $n>0$ and

Write $\operatorname{SphereDetected}(s,t,k,x,a)$ for the corresponding nonzero detection in the untruncated sphere.

entries.label: paper:1.5
entries.title: Survivors on the Adams 2-line
entries.chapter: Main — The permanence argument
entries.body:
\textit{(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 1.5.)}


    On the Adams 2-line, the only non-trivial elements that survive in the Adams spectral sequence are:
    $$h_0h_2, \ h_0h_3, \ h_2h_4, \ h_1h_j \ (j \geq 3), \ h_j^2 \ (j \leq 6).$$




\par\emph{Proof.} Write any nonzero second-line class as a standard product using the exhaustive $E_2$ basis. Its third-page continuation restricts it to the corrected Adams--Lin--Leibniz candidates, including $h_0h_4$. Four exceptional mixed products support nonzero outgoing differentials, while HHR excludes squares of index at least seven. Conversely, the remaining products survive by the low-dimensional, Mahowald-family and Kervaire literature inputs, together with the main $h_6^2$ theorem.

lean.name: KIP126.Main.adams_two_line_classification
lean.code:
public theorem adams_two_line_classification : AdamsTwoLineClassification := by
  intro t x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i,j,hij,degree,heq⟩ := KIP126.E2Computation.two_line_exhaustive t x
      (survival_nonzero hx)
    have hp := (survival_regrade degree (KIP126.Literature.Standard.hiProduct i j)).mp
      (heq ▸ hx)
    exact ⟨i,j,surviving_pair_listed i j hij hp,degree,heq⟩
  · rintro ⟨i,j,hij,degree,heq⟩
    rw [heq]
    exact (survival_regrade degree (KIP126.Literature.Standard.hiProduct i j)).mpr
      (listed_pair_survives i j hij)

entries.label: paper:7.8
entries.title: The last differential and its detection conditions
entries.chapter: Main — The permanence argument
entries.body:
\textit{(From \cite{LWX126}, Proposition 7.8.)}


Exactly one of the following two statements is true:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item[(1)] The element $h_6^2$ survives to the $E_\infty$-page.
   
    \item[(2)] There is a nonzero classical Adams differential 
    $$d_{12}(h_6^2) = h_1h_4x_{109,12}.$$
\end{enumerate}
Furthermore, statement $(2)$ is true if and only if the following three statements are all true:
\begin{enumerate} 
    \item[(3)] \leavevmode  
    $$d_6(x_{126,8,4} + x_{126,8}) = 0.$$
    
    \item[(4)] There exists a $\theta_5$ such that 
    $\theta_5^2$ is detected by $\lambda^6 h_0^2x_{124,8}$. In particular, 
    $$\theta_5^2 = \lambda^6 [h_0^2x_{124,8}] \neq 0 \in \pi_{124,124+4}S^{0,0}$$
    for some $[h_0^2x_{124,8}]$.

    \item[(5)] There exists a homotopy class $[h_0^2x_{124,8}]$ such that
    $\lambda^3 \eta [h_0^2x_{124,8}]$ is detected by $\lambda^6 h_1h_4x_{109,12}$. In particular, we have 
    $$\lambda^3 \eta [h_0^2x_{124,8}] = \lambda^6 [h_1h_4x_{109,12}] \in \pi_{125,125+8} S^{0,0}$$
    for some $[h_1h_4x_{109,12}]$.
\end{enumerate}

      (H6SquareSupportsD12 ↔ Stem126D6Vanishes ∧ Theta5SquareNonzeroDetection ∧ EtaExtensionDetection) := by

  · rcases permanence_or_d12 with hp | hd
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hp, fun hd => (d12_necessary hd).1 hp⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hd, (d12_necessary hd).1⟩
  · constructor
    · intro hd
      exact ⟨(d12_necessary hd).2, d12_implies_square_and_eta hd⟩
    · rintro ⟨h3, h4, h5⟩

entries.title: A framed manifold of Kervaire invariant one in dimension $126$
entries.chapter: Geometry --- Framed Manifolds of Kervaire Invariant One
entries.body:
\textit{(From \cite{LWX126}, Theorem 1.1.)}


    There exist framed manifolds of Kervaire invariant one in dimension 126.

comments.author: blueprint-authoring
comments.title: Formal scope and provenance
comments.text:
**Formal scope:** Not formalized: geometric endpoint.

Existence of a framed 126-dimensional manifold of Kervaire invariant one is not yet formalized. The current formal endpoint is nonzero permanence of the standard $h_6^2$ class.

entries.label: paper:1.2
entries.title: Dimensions admitting Kervaire invariant one
entries.chapter: Geometry --- Framed Manifolds of Kervaire Invariant One
entries.body:
\textit{(From \cite{LWX126}, Corollary 1.2.)}

The dimensions that there exist framed manifolds of Kervaire invariant one are 2, 6, 14, 30, 62, and 126.

comments.author: blueprint-authoring
comments.title: Formal scope and provenance
comments.text:
**Formal scope:** Not formalized: geometric endpoint.

The complete dimensional classification is not formalized. The repository has no public manifold-existence theorem or exclusion theorem covering precisely these dimensions.
